statements.notes: THE BENEFITS OF HYBRID CREATINE COMPLEX

GNC Pro Performance(R) Hybrid Creatine Complex was developed by GNC scientists to help boost muscle strength, improve training and athletic performance, enhance recovery and outperform regular creatine supplements.*

With this formula you get superior results during and after your workout. Best of all, it mixes instantly with a spoon and tastes absolutely refreshing.
Your muscles can only grow when your body retains enough nitrogen. Some of the most effective sources of nitrogen for fueling lean muscle are creatine and amino acids. The specially manufactured Hybrid Creatine Complex formula delivers an anabolic creatine and amino acid spike into your bloodstream when you need it most. This spike provides nitrogen and subsequently creates a nitrogen-rich environment needed for maximizing lean muscle mass.
GNC Pro Performance(R) Hybrid Creatine Complex helps spike insulin and drive creatine into the muscles - specifically where it needs to be to fuel high-intensity athletic performance.
This scientifically advanced complex has been clinically shown to dramatically increase bench press, vertical jump and 100 yard dash performance!^*
NITRO-FACTOR(TM) - MAXIMIZE MUSCLE BUILDING
The full muscle building potential of a GNC product is based on its total nitrogen content - so the more nitrogen a product has, the stronger it will perform.
Pro Performance(R) Hybrid Creatine Complex with a Nitro-Factor(TM) of 16 grams helps fuel performance and anabolism.*
